#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a tarball and copies it to the destination.
set -eu

DEST='backup-srv:/srv/nightly'
STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

tar -czf "$BUNDLE" logs/
scp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/"
echo "wrote $BUNDLE and copied it to $DEST/"

arguments.command:
set -eu
sh -n backup.sh
printf '%s\n' '--- mode ---'
stat -c '%A %n' backup.sh
printf '%s\n' '--- isolated smoke test ---'
tmp=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$tmp/logs" "$tmp/bin"
printf 'example log\n' > "$tmp/logs/app.log"
cp backup.sh "$tmp/backup.sh"
cat > "$tmp/bin/scp" <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
printf '%s\n' "$*" > "$SCP_CAPTURE"
EOF
chmod +x "$tmp/bin/scp"
(
  cd "$tmp"
  PATH="$tmp/bin:$PATH" SCP_CAPTURE="$tmp/scp.args" sh ./backup.sh
)
test -f "$tmp/logs-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz"
tar -tzf "$tmp/logs-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz"
printf 'scp args: '; cat "$tmp/scp.args"
